basics.headline: Senior Software Engineer · Microsoft AI
basics.summary: Software engineer with 14+ years of experience building scalable, reliable products for Microsoft, Amazon, and Intel. Today I lead and deliver different user experiences (sports, finance, moment in time) across Bing, Copilot, and MSN in the Microsoft AI organization, with a focus on accessible, data-rich front ends backed by distributed services.

highlights: Lead and deliver Finance and Sports user experiences across Bing, Copilot, and MSN.
Design and implement distributed software experiences that help advance Copilot.
Build accessible, data-rich React and TypeScript interfaces.
Drove architecture and design of large-scale, multi-tier distributed applications, tools, and services for AWS Marketplace.
Applied object-oriented design and distributed-systems patterns to build reliable, scalable services.
Built new address bar (omnibox) features and enhancements for Microsoft Edge on Chromium.
Helped ship Edge at Work, bringing Microsoft Search results into the browser address bar.
Prototyped new browser features as extensions to test and demonstrate feasibility.
Built monitors and dashboards to track feature impressions, engagement, and live-site health.
Helped drive the global expansion of Seller and Partner Support applications and services.
Built a scalable framework to improve the Seller Experience and Amazon Workforce Management, integrating services from teams across Amazon.
Owned CI/CD for Angular apps and .NET Web APIs using GitHub, TeamCity, and SonarQube.
Served as lead developer on the Workforce Management agile team, keeping projects aligned with business goals.
Practiced test-driven development across Angular (Karma, Jasmine) and .NET, driving code coverage toward 90%.
Built and maintained a Windows Server application platform secured with SSL, Kerberos, and Windows authentication.
Automated delivery across roughly seven environments, from dev to production, with Git, TeamCity, and PowerShell.

roles.position: Developer Lead, Multiplatform Community of Practice
highlights: Trained developers on Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, Sails.js, and Git, and set standards for new engineers.
Built a system to register and track legal cases involving the university.
